'''Kyoopid''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who represented his [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Festival of Love|Ewok Festival of Love]].

==Biography==
He made pilgrimages to [[Kaadara]], [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and the [[Southern Ewok Lake Village]]. It was at those three locations that [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] attempted to honor him by giving him love cards or [[Chak heart]]s.

==Personality and traits==
Kyoopid was just like any other Ewok, except that he dyed his fur and wore wings with [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties. These wings kept him afloat, in a similar fashion to that of [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]]. He marked his chest and back leg with painted hearts -- a universal symbol of love throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kyoopid is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) that makes appearance during the Ewok Festival of Love Celebrations in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was introduced during the Festival of Love of [[2009]], and has since made appearances during each subsequent, yearly event. Players attempt to locate him and give him a bundled pack of love cards or Chak Hearts. In exchange, Kyoopid gives the player a badge.

The name Kyoopid appeared to be a reference to [[Wikipedia:Cupid|Cupid]] of [[Wikipedia:Valentine's Day|Valentine's Day]]. This was further reinforced by the fact that one of the Festival of Love quests was titled, ''Playing Cupid''.
